preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 100,000 vertices and between 0 and 200,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 0 <= t <= 10**18 for u, v, t in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct vertices within the valid range, and each edge has a non-negative integer weight up to 10^18.
The input contains exactly m edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v, s in interesting_triples)
postconditions.description: Each interesting triple (u, v, s) satisfies 1 ≤ u < v ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(1 <= x <= n for x in path) and all((path[i], path[i+1]) in edges or (path[i+1], path[i]) in edges for i in range(len(path)-1)) for path in paths) for u, v, s in interesting_triples)
postconditions.description: For each interesting triple (u, v, s), there exists at least one path from u to v where the XOR of edge weights along the path equals s.

postconditions.expression: sum(s for u, v, s in interesting_triples) % (10**9 + 7) == int(stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of all s values from interesting triples modulo 10^9 + 7.
